description: Questions a grocery shopper might ask that Kirana's policies do NOT answer. The right behaviour is to say so, not to stretch a loosely related passage into an answer.
provenance: hand-written; each checked against kb/seed to make sure no document answers it

cases.query: Do you have a loyalty points programme?
What warranty do you give on electronics like headphones?
How do I apply for a job as a delivery partner?
Who is the founder of Kirana?
Do you have a physical store in Pune I can visit?
Can I schedule a recurring weekly order?
What is your policy on plastic bags and packaging recycling?
Can I get a GST invoice for my business purchases?
What are the nutritional values of your house-brand atta?
